name: get_stock
description: Current stock on hand for one SKU: the latest daily snapshot per location (warehouse, store_a, store_b), the total, and the SKU's reorder point.

name: get_sales
description: Units sold, revenue, gross margin and average daily units for one SKU over the last N days (ending on the latest data date), split by channel.

days.description: Window length in days, 1 to 90. Default 28.

name: get_lead_time
description: Supplier lead time in days, reorder point and unit cost for one SKU.

name: list_low_cover
description: SKUs with fewer days of cover than the threshold, or at/below their reorder point, sorted from most urgent. Days of cover = on hand / average daily units. Includes a baseline order quantity computed in code.

days.description: Flag SKUs with less than this many days of cover. Default 21.

lookback_days.description: Days of sales used for the average. Default 28.

name: list_dead_stock
description: SKUs that have stock on hand but no sales in the lookback window, with the stock value at cost.

lookback_days.description: Days without sales to count as dead stock. Default 60.

name: list_rejected
description: Rows the validator rejected, with file, line, reason code, plain-words reason and the raw row, plus counts per reason.

limit.description: Most recent rows to return, 1 to 200. Default 20.

file.description: Only rows from this uploaded file name.

name: get_week_summary
description: Numbers for the weekly report: revenue vs last week, units, orders, gross margin, sales by channel, top 5 SKUs, low cover list, dead stock, and data quality counts.

end_date.description: Last day of the week, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: latest data date.

name: save_approval
description: Save a reorder suggestion as a Pending row in the Approvals sheet for a human to approve or reject. It never places an order or contacts a supplier.

reason.description: Why, using numbers from the tools.
